description: The Wildland Fire Data Portal gives public access to NOAA satellite fire data produced by the Next Generation Fire System (NGFS). NGFS analyses large volumes of satellite data to identify heat signatures consistent with active fires, then tracks and records each fire's spread and intensity, and the results are published through the portal together with imagery and analytical tools for firefighting and resource management. NESDIS notes that NGFS can detect some fires faster than ground systems. The portal is one of the NESDIS Common Cloud Framework portals; the same framework hosts NOAA's Space Weather Portal (SPOT), launched in 2025 for cloud access to space weather data. Access is free and public; no licence is stated beyond NOAA's public data status. Caveats: detections come from geostationary satellites over the Americas, with resolution limits for small fires. It supports wildfire hazard exposure and emergency response studies for power lines, roads and communities; a related record is NASA FIRMS active fire data.
